description: The >>PROPAGATE { ON | OFF } compiler directive (ISO §2023:7.3.21) - automatic propagation of an unhandled exception condition to the activating runtime element. Recognized and operand-validated by PropagateDirectiveProcessor (the runtime propagation effect is the deferred PHASE-13 EC work); the introduction gate rejects the directive word below 2002 through the ONE ConstructRegistry funnel - it emitted a bespoke COBOL0883 until kb/Work PB725, which left COBOL0883 owning only the malformed-operand half. The §2023:7.3 compiler-directive facility is a COBOL-2002 introduction: COBOL-85 has no compiler directives at all, so a '>>' line cannot occur in a conforming COBOL-85 source. The edition edge below 2023 is DERIVED, not quoted (VCR Table 7's discipline, rows 7.19/7.20 - the repo holds no 2002 or 2014 text, ratified decision #1): the derivation is (a) the M2 post-85 feature catalog in docs/ISO2023_CONFORMANCE_PLAN.md, which places '*>' inline comments, >>SOURCE FORMAT, conditional compilation and 'recognize-and-ignore of the other standard >> directives' in COBOL-2002, (b) the sibling row leap-second-directive-2002, already landed on the same derivation (kb/Work PB65), and (c) Annex E, which itemizes the 2014->2023 delta and does NOT list this directive among the additions, so it predates 2023. Overturnable in one line if the 2002/2014 text is ever acquired.
citation: ISO §2023:7.3.21; the §2023:7.3 compiler-directive facility is a COBOL-2002 introduction (M2 catalog derivation, VCR Table 7 discipline)

directivePlacement.text: A PROPAGATE directive shall not be specified within a compilation unit

directiveOperand.citation: ISO §2023:7.3.21.2 general format: PROPAGATE and OFF are underlined, ON is not, so per §2023:5.2.3 the ON alternative may be selected with the word omitted; §2023:7.3.21.4 GR4's OFF default is about omitting the DIRECTIVE, not about which alternative the format implies.

source:
>>PROPAGATE ON
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. PB725PR.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           DISPLAY "X".
           STOP RUN.
